atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(50, "Coil Lookback", 10, 150, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
coilThresh = input(0.75, "Coil Threshold", 0.1, 0.95, 0.05)
relMult = input(1.5, "Release Range Multiplier", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
trMax = max(tr1, max(tr2, tr3))
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
atrHigh = highest(atrVal, coilLen)
rngHigh = highest(rng, coilLen)
coilLoad = 1 - atrVal / max(atrHigh, 0.00000001)
coilLoadC = min(max(coilLoad, 0), 1)
rangeCoil = 1 - rng / max(rngHigh, 0.00000001)
rangeCoilC = min(max(rangeCoil, 0), 1)
loadFinal = (coilLoadC + rangeCoilC) / 2
atrAvg = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = stdev(atrVal, vovLen) / max(atrAvg, 0.00000001)
vovRising = vov > vov[1]
den = 0.0
k = 0
while k < predLen {
  den = den + abs(close[k] - close[k + 1])
  k = k + 1
}
num = abs(close - close[predLen])
predRaw = num / max(den, 0.00000001)
predRead = min(max(predRaw, 0), 1)
relBasis = sma(rng, coilLen)
expansion = rng > relBasis * relMult
loaded = loadFinal > coilThresh
wasLoaded = loaded[1]
releaseUp = wasLoaded and vovRising and expansion and close > open
releaseDn = wasLoaded and vovRising and expansion and close < open
predictable = predRead > 0.5
coilState = loaded ? (predictable ? 2.0 : 1.0) : 0.0
relMark = releaseUp ? 2.5 : (releaseDn ? 2.5 : coilState)
coneUpSize = min(max((rng / max(atrVal, 0.00000001)) * 0.7, 0.6), 2.2) * markerSize
coneDnSize = min(max((rng / max(atrVal, 0.00000001)) * 0.7, 0.6), 2.2) * markerSize

if releaseUp { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if releaseDn { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if releaseUp { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Release Up", "coneup", "#22cc88", coneUpSize, 2, "separate") }
if releaseDn { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Release Dn", "conedown", "#ff4477", coneDnSize, 2, "separate") }

bgcolor(loaded ? "#22aaff" : "#00000000", "separate")
plot(loadFinal, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predRead, "Predictability", "#ff9f43", 1, "separate")
plot(coilThresh, "Coil Threshold", "#aaaaaa", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(loadFinal, "Coil Load", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predRead, "Predictability", "surface", "#ff9f43", "separate", 1)
plot3d(relMark, "Release Pillars", "bars3d", "#ffd43b", "separate", 2)

SessionStartHour = input(0, "Session Start Hour", 0, 23, 1)
SessionEndHour = input(24, "Session End Hour", 0, 24, 1)
StructureLookback = input(20, "Structure Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
BreakConfirmBars = input(2, "Break Confirm Bars", 1, 10, 1)
StopBufferTicks = input(2, "Stop Buffer Ticks", 0, 20, 1)

sessSpan = SessionEndHour - SessionStartHour
sessSpanFix = sessSpan > 0 ? sessSpan : sessSpan + 24
sessBars = sessSpanFix > 0 ? sessSpanFix : 24
sessHigh = highest(high, sessBars)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessBars)
rngChart = sessHigh - sessLow

htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfClose = security("1h", close)
swingHigh = highest(htfHigh, StructureLookback)
swingLow = lowest(htfLow, StructureLookback)
priorHigh = swingHigh[1]
priorLow = swingLow[1]
htfRange = priorHigh - priorLow
bullCond = htfClose > priorHigh
bearCond = htfClose < priorLow

var bullHold = 0
var bearHold = 0

if bullCond {
    bullHold := bullHold[1] + 1
}
if not bullCond {
    bullHold := 0
}
if bearCond {
    bearHold := bearHold[1] + 1
}
if not bearCond {
    bearHold := 0
}

bullConf = bullHold >= BreakConfirmBars
bearConf = bearHold >= BreakConfirmBars
tickEst = close * 0.0001
bufPx = StopBufferTicks * tickEst
longStop = sessLow - bufPx
shortStop = sessHigh + bufPx
longStopDist = close > 0 ? abs(close - longStop) / close * 100 : 2.0
shortStopDist = close > 0 ? abs(shortStop - close) / close * 100 : 2.0
distHigh = abs(close - sessHigh)
distLow = abs(close - sessLow)
nearHigh = rngChart > 0 ? distHigh < rngChart * 0.25 : 0
nearLow = rngChart > 0 ? distLow < rngChart * 0.25 : 0
dispBull = htfClose - priorHigh
dispBear = priorLow - htfClose
dispBullOk = htfRange > 0 ? dispBull > htfRange * 0.1 : dispBull > 0
dispBearOk = htfRange > 0 ? dispBear > htfRange * 0.1 : dispBear > 0
scoreBullBase = bullConf ? 50 : 0
scoreBullNear = nearHigh ? 25 : 0
scoreBullDisp = dispBullOk ? 25 : 0
scoreBearBase = bearConf ? 50 : 0
scoreBearNear = nearLow ? 25 : 0
scoreBearDisp = dispBearOk ? 25 : 0
scoreBull = scoreBullBase + scoreBullNear + scoreBullDisp
scoreBear = scoreBearBase + scoreBearNear + scoreBearDisp
confBull = scoreBull / 100
confBear = scoreBear / 100
buySig = crossover(close, sessHigh[1]) and bullConf
sellSig = crossunder(close, sessLow[1]) and bearConf
exitLongSig = crossunder(close, sessLow[1]) or low <= longStop
exitShortSig = crossover(close, sessHigh[1]) or high >= shortStop

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confBull)
    model.stopLoss(longStopDist)
    model.longEntry("siege-long")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confBear)
    model.stopLoss(shortStopDist)
    model.shortEntry("siege-short")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLongSig {
    model.longExit("siege-long")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit Long", "triangledown", "#ffcc00")
}
if exitShortSig {
    model.shortExit("siege-short")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit Short", "triangleup", "#ffcc00")
}
plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
